description: Have you ever encountered the exact same news story across multiple websites, sometimes just seconds apart? News Factories investigates the phenomenon of “replication” of news within the Bulgarian online media landscape, exploring what the repetition and circulation of news can reveal about the power structures shaping digital media.

description: This visualization shows how conflicts have involved countries throughout history, from 1816 to 1945. It displays the number of countries where wars occurred or in which they participated, as well as the number of conflicts per year. The graphic distinguishes between interstate wars, wars internal to individual states, and the involvement of countries in the internal conflicts of other states (extra-state conflicts). The data are drawn from the Historical Conflict Dataset.

description: The Social Museum is a research-led installation exploring how social media shapes the way we experience contemporary art. By analyzing thousands of Instagram images from six major contemporary art museums, the project examines the relationship between genuine engagement and performative behavior in gallery spaces.

media.description: Through an interactive exploration of visitor poses and their positioning in relation to artworks, the installation invites visitors to reflect on their own behavior and question where engagement ends and performance begins.

description: The visualization displays eruptions over time for each of the 46 volcanoes that were still active in 2025. Each circle represents an eruption, with its start and end points marked on a timeline beginning in 1900. The size of the dots indicates the event's intensity according to the Volcanic Explosivity Index (VEI), while the color highlights whether the eruptions were long-lasting or brief. The elevation and geographic location of each volcano are also indicated.

description: This visualization compares data on asteroids that have made close approaches to Earth with confirmed impact sites listed in the official Earth Impact Database. The analysis highlights the frequency and distance of the most recent close encounters, as well as the geological traces left by past impacts.
